pr_title: Support EndpointGroupName metadata in MVC ApiExplorer

issue_context.title: Respect `EndpointGroupName` attributes in MVC ApiExplorer
issue_context.body:
In https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/34906, we introduced a new `EndpointGroupName` attribute that can be applied to endpoints and used to populate the `GroupName` property in ApiExplorer.

We need to support this in MVC as well.
comments: We've moved this issue to the Backlog milestone. This means that it is not going to be worked on for the coming release. We will reassess the backlog following the current release and consider this item at that time. review_comments: Could you add an additional unit tests to exercise the fallback path (when both EndpointGroupName and GroupName are specified)?
